# Board Meeting Notes: October 21, 2026
Attendees: Edward Lambright (Chair), Daniel Swan, Naira Ahmed, Leon Collman, Sharon Bao. Victoria Wang (CFO) for Item 1. Rahul Bhatnagar (GC) for exec session.

## 1. CFO Financial Update (V. Wang)
- Q3 net loss of $287M, up from $141M in Q2.
- Liquidity down to approx. 4 months runway at current burn.
- Minimum liquidity covenant under revolving credit facility projected to be breached in Q1 2027. Agent bank issued a notice of potential default on Oct 15.
- Cross-default exposure to 2028 notes if RCF is accelerated.
- Three restructuring scenarios presented: (a) lease portfolio renegotiation, (b) sale-leaseback of select properties, (c) Chapter 11 contingency planning with outside counsel.
- Board requested a restructuring committee. Ahmed to chair; first meeting week of Nov 9.

## 2. Litigation Update (R. Bhatnagar, exec session)
- Ad hoc noteholder group filed suit in Delaware Chancery on Oct 3. Discovery expected to open Q1 2027.

## 3. Other Items
- Approved Q4 lease amendments (Austin, Madrid).
- Compensation committee report deferred to November.

## Post-Meeting Correspondence (forwarded to records 10/27)

[10/24, Lambright to Swan, Ahmed, Collman, Bao]: With the Chancery suit, anything in the minutes can end up in discovery. I'd like the official minutes kept high-level: "Management provided an update on the company's capital position and strategic options." Please leave out the covenant language, the default notice, and the scenario detail. We can brief the restructuring committee verbally.

[10/24, Swan]: Agreed. Victoria's deck should not be attached to the record either.

[10/25, Ahmed]: I'm uneasy about dropping the default notice entirely. It's material and the committee needs it in writing.

[10/25, Lambright]: Understood, but the minutes are a corporate record and I don't want them read as an admission. We'll handle the detail through the committee. Let's keep this between the board for now.

[10/26, Collman]: +1 to Ed's approach.
